text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Here we are at the fourth corner!
Every Umamusume is launching into a full spurt from here!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (—I'll show them...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Witness my run!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Katsuragi!
Katsuragi Ace is out in front!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Katsuragi Ace won, huh?
With CB out of the picture right now,
I guess she really is the front-runner Umamusume~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: ...I never paid much attention before, but Katsuragi Ace is actually pretty strong, isn't she...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'll look into their background a bit.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Hell yeah! Totally had 'em!
No question that was a crushing victory this time!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was the best way to win!
Yeah, that was the best way to win!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Alright, next up is the Takarazuka Kinen! Heheh, I'm so pumped...!

Following this victory, Katsuragi Ace
seems to have taken on a newfound air of dignity.
If she wins the Takarazuka Kinen with this momentum, she should easily cement her presence as the undisputed strongest at medium distances...!
choice_data_list: We must win the Takarazuka Kinen too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's eat some delicious grub tonight and hype ourselves up!!

And so, concluding the Osaka Hai safely
with momentum for what lay ahead—

—A few days later.
A certain "change" began to appear.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text: "I was curious after the Osaka Hai so I looked up Katsuragi Ace's history, and wow. She never belonged to any club, and apparently her parents have zero racing experience either."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text: "Incredible. Getting into Tracen Academy like this... just how hard did she work? Honestly, winning a G1 with that background is downright insane."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't this great? Pure underdog spirit...!
Looking into her gave me a bit of courage.
I really wanna see a girl like this rise to the top~"
"...Ever since the Osaka Hai, there has been a noticeable trend on social media of attention gradually gathering around Katsuragi Ace."

Most of them were favorable pieces regarding her background—
moving from the local circuit to the capital all on her own
and rising to the top through pure hard work...
I must do everything in my power to show an even stronger run in the next Takarazuka Kinen...!

"As a Trainer,
I braced myself with renewed determination—"
